withdrawal.what: withdraws consent after Period 1 (no Period 2 dose)

emesis.what: vomits 45 minutes after the Period 2 dose

carryover.what: measurable Period 2 pre-dose concentration at 2.5% of that period's Cmax (below the 5% rule)

missed.what: 12 h sample in Period 1 not collected

late_sample.what: 4 h sample in Period 1 drawn 25 minutes late

mid_blq.what: 6 h sample in Period 2 reported below the LLOQ between quantifiable samples (a simulated sample-handling problem; no reassay)
